title: A Boundary-Metric Evaluation Protocol for Whiteboard Stroke Segmentation Under Extreme Imbalance
mechanism: Protocol combining region and boundary metrics, a thin-subset equity analysis, per-image median/IQR/worst case and seeded multi-run non-parametric tests.
adaptation: Thin subset = crack components < 20 px (76-88% of components) vs longer cracks, per source.
min_experiment: Arm: metrics on thin vs long crack subsets. Kill: same ranking in both subsets for all arms.
evidence: R: 12 test images, 5 losses x 3 runs; overlap losses beat CE by >20 F1 points (p<0.001); classical baseline higher mean F1 but worse worst-case.
prior_overlap: partial: components >= 20 px recall already reported.
